verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents job APIs for creating processing jobs, triggering runs and monitoring their status, which covers the async-job and status-polling parts of the story. Nothing in the pack shows registrable completion webhooks, so the developer must poll. missing for 10: documented completion webhooks/outbound HTTP callbacks, explicit polling-endpoint details, independent or hands-on corroboration of async behavior on long parses.

support.subject: As a developer, long parses run as async jobs with status polling and completion webhooks, so my pipeline never blocks

citations.quote: Track and control the processing jobs that execute your workflows.
Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Create a job to partition, chunk, and embed local files into AI-ready JSON with vector embeddings for semantic search.
